sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Gaza Government Media Office, via Times of Israel + Al Mayadeen + Palinfo, Nov 7] Rain has flooded 70,000 tents housing displaced Gazans over the past 12 hours, and winter conditions have caused an estimated $3 million in damage so far. Dozens of walls have collapsed in various parts of the Strip, causing some injuries. Gaza Civil Defence fielded over 1,500 weather-related emergency calls; it says the scale exceeds what it can handle alone. The GMO accuses Israel of refusing to let shelters and equipment to handle the rain enter the Strip; Israel says it restricts entry of equipment that could be used as weapons and has accused Hamas of looting humanitarian aid. [CONTEXT -- UN OCHA, Oct 15, via Al Mayadeen] ~950,000 displaced Palestinians live in areas of moderate or high flood risk. [CONTEXT -- GMO / Ministry of Social Development, via Palinfo/Al Mayadeen] Gaza needs 260,000 new tents; 162,000 of ~270,000 displacement tents are severely damaged or unusable; the territory requires ~200,000 weather-resistant tents and 300,000 emergency shelter kits. [SOCIAL PROOF] A Facebook reel of a man filming inside his flooded tent at night ('Gaza -- We are drowning') drew 14K likes / 620 comments; an Al Jazeera rain report reel drew 10K likes / 610 comments (demand-check zeitgeist-20261107-1700-gaza-flood-toll.xml).
sections.what_verified: Times of Israel (T3) carries the GMO statement; Al Mayadeen and Palinfo carry the same figures (untiered -- not in registry, attribution only).
sections.what_disputed: The 70,000 count is the GMO's own figure, not independently verified. Israel's position: restrictions target dual-use equipment; Hamas loots aid (Times of Israel). The GMO is a Hamas-run body; its figures are its own claims.
sections.why_matters: 70,000 tents underwater in 12 hours. Families are drowning in their own shelters -- and winter has only just started. Who blocked the tents from getting in?
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Palinfo 2026-11-07T13:13:12+02:00 = 15:13 ; zero '70,000' mentions in any prior Nov 6/7 scan -- grep confirms; the 1200-05(g) 'GAZA RAIN' entry carried only the early 'hundreds of tents' figure) -- Gaza first winter storm: 70,000 tents flooded in 12 hours, $3m damage

totw_analysis: Our read: 70,000 tents underwater in 12 hours. Families are drowning in their own shelters -- and winter has only just started. Who blocked the tents from getting in? The fault line our audience is arguing over: Israel blocks shelter materials -- or Hamas steals the aid? Who is responsible for Gazans drowning in their tents?
